newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar ends softer after sluggish day.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar ends softer after sluggish day.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar ended softer at C$1.3426 (US$0.7449) from Friday's close at C$1.3407 (US$0.7459) after a sluggish session on Monday, dealers said. * The currency traded within a narrow range today as investors paid more attention to a surging U.S. dollar, dealers said. * They said the Canada unit is expected to weaken slightly overnight.
While the underlying tone of the currency was bullish, the Canadian dollar continued to weaken as part of a temporary retracement from higher levels set earlier this month, Wateridge said.
He said he expected the currency to soften slightly overnight and continue trading in light volumes the rest of the week as the United States celebrated Thanksgiving on Thursday.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.1339 marks from Friday's close of 1.1234 marks and edged up to 83.88 yen from 83.03 yen.
